description: Read a page from this company's private memory wiki — Finn's long-term per-company notes (preferences, decisions, people, recurring Q&A). Call with slug="index" first to list available pages.

company.description: Which company to read, by name or id, when the account has more than one (see list_companies). Leave it out to use the only company, or the default.

slug.description: Page slug (e.g. "index", or a specific topic). Defaults to "index".
